# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **$8.6M in eCat GMV across 3,983 orders** — eCat ordering volume averaged 330 orders per month over the trailing 12 months, with the most recent quarter (March–May 2026) showing a 16% uptick over the prior three months. [→ §commerce]
2. **eCat captures 9.8% of total business GMV** — with $87.1M flowing through all channels trailing 12 months, eCat's higher-value order mix ($2,147 AOV vs. ~$1,511 all-channel average) means it captures a larger GMV share than its 6.9% order count share. [→ §commerce]
3. **Exceptionally diversified buyer base** — no single buyer exceeds 1.9% of eCat GMV, and the top 5 combined represent just 6.4% of the trailing 12-month total, indicating broad platform adoption with no concentration risk. [→ §commerce]
4. **Quote workflow carries 2.2× AOV premium** — at $4,818 per quote vs. $2,147 overall trailing 12 months, expanding quote adoption could meaningfully lift average transaction size with only 108 quotes placed. [→ §commerce]
